library.name: Etherkit JTEncode
library.author: Jason Milldrum <milldrum@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Generate JT65, JT9, JT4, FT8, WSPR, and FSQ symbols on your Arduino.
library.paragraph: This library very simply generates a set of channel symbols for JT65, JT9, JT4, FT8, or WSPR based on the user providing a properly formatted Type 6 message for JT65, JT9, or JT4 (which is 13 valid characters), Type 0.0 or 0.5 message for FT8 (v2.0.0 protocol) or a callsign, Maidenhead grid locator, and power output for WSPR. It will also generate an arbitrary FSQ message of up to 130 characters (non-directed) or 100 characters (directed). When paired with a synthesizer that can output frequencies in fine, phase-continuous tuning steps (such as the Si5351), then a beacon or telemetry transmitter can be created which can change the transmitted characters as needed from the Arduino.

library.name: WeeklyAlarm
library.author: Nitrof
library.sentence: Weekly day-of-week alarm scheduler for recurring time-based callbacks.
library.paragraph: WeeklyAlarm triggers callbacks at a set time on selected days of the week, inspired by programmable thermostat schedulers. Supports lambdas, functors and function pointers. Compatible with STM32/newlib (POSIX time) and classic Arduino (TimeLib) platforms via automatic detection.
